result.one_liner: Support and helpdesk platform with messaging, email, and team collaboration features.

evidence.quote: Front supports OAuth 2.0 and API Tokens for authentication... The Core API uses Bearer tokens to authenticate its user.
API access is included on all plans, with usage limits based on your plan. Starter supports up to 50 requests per minute.
API calls will always work with https://api2.frontapp.com as the base URL.

result.notes: Front requires a paid subscription to access the API—no free tier API access found. OAuth 2.0 recommended for public integrations; bearer tokens for single-customer integrations. API rate limits included in plan; higher limits available as add-ons. Exact endpoint count not documented; MCP support not found in official documentation.
